rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=72, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-8: KNOB=pretrain_epochs 56->72 (single change; KEEP itnet_k=1 and residual_learning=False from iter-6/7, KEEP pretrain_lr=1e-3, train_n=200, val_n=8). PRIOR RESULTS: iter-6 (ep40,k=1)=0.9648, iter-7 (ep56,k=1)=0.9608 -- the ep40->ep56 epochs lever did NOT lift (0.9608 sits marginally BELOW 0.9648, inside val_n=8 noise) so the k=1 score has PLATEAUED in the ep40-56 band, ~0.965, still short of the prior itnet_v2 run peak of 0.9714. FAILURE MODE: either ep56 is just short of the proven prior optimum the campaign record pins at exactly ep72/k=1 (epochs not quite saturated; the ep56 read may be val-noise-masked at val_n=8), OR 0.965 is the real config ceiling. DEFINITIVE TEST: pretrain_epochs->72 is the proven prior optimum and the ONLY untried lever with positive evidence -- the campaign record rules OUT unet_c=32 / train_n=300 / seed / lr-0.6x (ALL worse on the prior run). The earlier ep60 COLLAPSE (iter-5, 0.4453) was at k=3 (broken over-constraint regime), NOT a k=1 overfit signal, so ep72 at k=1 is inside the proven envelope, not past an overfit cliff. HYPOTHESIS: at k=1, ep72 is the proven prior optimum -> ~0.971; if it stays ~0.965 that IS the config ceiling and future iters document it. WALL GUARD: k=1 is cheap (iter-7 ep56/k=1 ran ~350s); ep72 ~= 1.3x -> ~450s, well under the 15-min cap. val_n=8 KEPT (not shrunk -- a clean read matters more than throughput here).
